topic: Guess the Telugu movie from emojis — 4 films, easy to hard (2012, 2019, 1991, 1955)

slides.sub: Only real TFI fans get full marks. Pick A, B or C before you swipe!

slides.label: Q1 • EASY
slides.question_en: 2012 • All three are S. S. Rajamouli films.

slides.te: హత్యకు గురైన యువకుడు ఈగగా మళ్ళీ పుడతాడు!
slides.en: S. S. Rajamouli's 2012 film: a murdered young man is reborn as a housefly and takes revenge on his killer.

slides.label: Q2 • MEDIUM
slides.question_en: 2019 • All three options have the same hero.

slides.en: Gowtam Tinnanuri's 2019 film: a failed cricketer makes a comeback in his mid-30s to gift his son an India team jersey.

slides.label: Q3 • HARD
slides.question_en: 1991 • All three are Singeetam Srinivasa Rao films.

slides.te: Time machine లో రాయల వారి ఆస్థానానికి!
slides.en: Singeetam Srinivasa Rao's 1991 film takes its heroes back to Sri Krishnadevaraya's court. Often called Indian cinema's first time-travel film.

slides.label: Q4 • HARDEST
slides.question_en: 1955 • All three are L. V. Prasad films.

slides.en: L. V. Prasad's 1955 film: two jobless graduates pretend to be married to get teaching jobs at a village school.
